citation.authors: Gopukumar K, Thanawala S, Somepalli V, Rao TSS et al

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.population: 130 healthy stressed adults aged 20 to 55 (125 completed); registered in the Clinical Trials Registry-India; ethnicity not stated
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 300 mg sustained-release extract once a day for 90 days
record.finding: Recall memory scores improved and pattern recall errors fell compared with placebo. Perceived stress, serum cortisol and sleep quality scores improved and happiness scores rose.
record.note: One branded product. Healthy stressed adults, not people with memory problems.
